title: centaurea pannonica
intro: Centaurea pannonica, commonly known as Hungarian ironwort, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea pannonica include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
